medium: two-ink Risograph film with deterministic per-frame SVG stencil printing

baseline.status: RISO26 facial crop verified; full 240-frame scene not yet visually reviewed
observations: The existing ensemble story has an absolute 0–239 film slider, but no edit-room cue points and no directly captured sequential contact sheet.
Source walking/body acting and mouth expressions are keyed in individual 2D human rigs and should be judged in consecutive frames, not only neutral/160/198 isolated face crops.

Letter handoff has source/shared/receiver phases and source-bound finger overprints. Its timing should be verified around 126, 160, 178, 202, and 239 as a visible motion, not inferred from source comments.

references.title: Crushed! Contact Sheet
references.creator: Zack Lydon; Zine Hug print
references.rights: creator-owned; observation and link only, no frames copied

observed.macro: The same character remains recognizably styled and ink-separated across a 21-panel printed sequence.
observed.meso: Eye lines and head angle vary purposefully across adjacent panels and concentrate on anticipation, response and release.
observed.micro: Real print granularity and registration vary only as material characteristics; ink/color identity persists panel to panel.

references.construction: Show captured consecutive source-rendered panels at authored beats; retain character source rigs and original cobalt/red ink overprints; inspect acting topology frame-to-frame.

references.title: Wind, Risograph animation printed by Zine Hug
references.creator: Zack Lydon, Zine Hug, TVPaint

observed.macro: Repeated film-frame cards of a person in landscape; original silhouette persists over pose progression.
observed.meso: Hair flow, head turn and mouth changes are controlled across closely spaced frames rather than a jump between isolated expressions.
observed.micro: Fine paper texture and small print registration features visible on the physical cards.

references.construction: Expose fixed held film frames and a reviewer contact sheet for the two characters; inspect that face source identity survives blink/utterance and hand transfer.

references.title: Ink Sundae multi-pose Risograph figure sketchbook
references.creator: Ink Sundae; image published by QDY Magazine
references.kind: primary printed poses, NOT confirmed animation

observed.macro: A single ink-separated human visual vocabulary appears in multiple poses and compositions.
observed.meso: Arm reach and walking pose are readable through negative gaps around elbows, coat/torso and feet.
observed.micro: Hair, collar and facial marks remain distinguishable with the same two spot colors.

references.construction: Preserve distinct limb overlap and actor identity in handoff; do not substitute stick-figure silhouettes, copied reference person or floating fingertips.

references.title: Zine Hug Risograph Animation
references.creator: Zine Hug (Alex Barsky, Zack Lydon)
references.rights: third-party; links and paraphrased process only

observed.macro: Animation is printed as many sequential frames arranged on physical sheets, later recomposed.
observed.meso: Frame counts for Crushed and Wind show that individual drawings must hold together across the whole timeline, not just one hero still.
observed.micro: Physical printed texture and registration are governed by the plate/separation process.

references.construction: Use a real source-timeline sweep and exportable captured browser sequential contact sheet to validate no illegal pops or temporal identity drift.

references.title: Riso Animations
references.creator: Megan Chong

observed.macro: Printed frame-by-frame motion retains high-contrast ink shape sequences and unusual cropping.
observed.meso: Continuous transitions expose unintended stencil jumps more clearly than single stills.
observed.micro: Natural print grain is stable in scene/film design rather than a frame-wise random digital filter.

references.construction: Do not add random per-frame paper grain, shake or unbounded puppet deformation to mimic motion; source paths and print plate deterministic.

spatial_structure.lighting: flat paper substrate; actual print geometry on native blue/red masters

negative_controls: do not fake 3/4 profile view by compressing the front rig
do not use detached hand/finger drawings to fake contact
do not delete microdetails to speed capture
do not frame-jitter RisoPrint seed or paper grain
no full-resolution source images copied from artist sites
do not approve film pacing without checking actual sequential captures
